description: This PHP trait provides functionality to retrieve and cache a chain of subunit IDs related to an entity in the OrangeHRM system, utilizing services for company structure. It is part of the DTO layer within the 'orangehrmPimPlugin' plugin of the OrangeHRM project.

methods.name: getSubunitIdChain
methods.description: Retrieves a cached chain of subunit IDs. If the chain isn't cached, it fetches it using the company structure service based on the subunit ID, which is obtained through a method expected to be implemented in the using class.
